_comment: Server settings. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored. Anything left out uses the built-in default.
_password: Must match the password in the Pi's pi_config.json.

decider._comment: backend: dummy, python or http. See the top of hookup.py.
decider._target: pipeline:decide = the local image pipeline in server/pipeline/. sign_decider:decide = the old remote CNN API (needs options.cnn_api_url).
decider._dummy_throttle: dummy backend: 1.0 = all wheels at full configured speed as soon as the car connects.
decider._options: Passed to the python module's configure(options). Free-form; the module decides what it needs.

options._stop_size_px: pipeline:decide only; optional (default 30, set in server/pipeline/__init__.py). The car stops once the stop sign's box is at least this many px tall (320x240 frame), and keeps driving until then. inches ~= 1070 / px: 30 ~= 36 in, 36 ~= 30 in, 45 ~= 24 in. 30 stopped the car in 21 of the 22 recorded drives of 2026-11-05. The page in ui/ can override it while it runs.
options._cnn_api_url: Only for target sign_decider:decide: the remote CNN API endpoint. Ask the CNN's owner; not kept in git.
